thread:
mira: heads up — saw a 502 spike hitting hosted-api edge in eu-west-1 around 10:12 UTC. Streaming sessions get an immediate RST, non-streaming calls mostly succeed. cc @ashok @jonathan

ashok: can you paste a sample failing curl + trace-id? also which model/route?

mira: here's a minimal repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'x-trace-id: trace-7a3b' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  'https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/chat?model=redwood-small' \
  --data-binary @input.json
```
response: 502 upstream_reset, trace-id: trace-7a3b
note: client was streaming ~1.4MB chunks, saw immediate RST on stream open.

ops-bot: alert: eu-west-1 edge svc 502-rate increased 350% in 1m window — incident created #INC-2026-984

jonathan: looking at envoy stats on node edge-eu-12: upstream_rq_5xx:+420, upstream_rq_timeouts:+38, h2_stream_errors:+190. pulling auth-proxy logs now.

ashok: possible auth-cache eviction + key rotation overlap. did we rotate keys recently?

mira: yes — key-rotation job ran at 10:05 UTC (key-id=k2026). rotation touched auth-cache replicas in eu-west.

elaine: any premium tenants hit? if so escalate to P1.

mira: 8 tenants impacted, 2 premium. opening support tickets and notifying CS.

jonathan: mitigation plan: bump auth-cache TTL to 30s on canary, restart one auth pod per AZ. also enable short-term fallback path in edge for streams.

ashok: applying canary ttl=30s now. will monitor. also preparing a small envoy retry patch to tolerate single auth 502s.

ops-bot: deploy: auth-cache/eu-west canary config update (ttl=30s) started by ashok at 10:28 UTC.

mira: after canary the 502 rate dropped ~70% over 5m. streaming resumes for affected customers. monitoring for 30m.

jonathan: trace after fix shows auth-proxy returned 200 -> edge at 10:29:12 for trace-7a3b. saving traces and logs to the incident.

ashok: follow-ups: add pre-rotation warmup (touch cache) for key rotations, add small jittered retries in edge for auth 502, run a post-rotation smoke for streaming routes. I'll open PRs.

mira: thanks team — I've posted the repro/curl to the support tickets and updated the incident with root cause hypothesis. :thumbsup:
